message.content:
A black-and-white magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters features a crowd of people. In the center, a shirtless man stands facing forward, wearing a netted head covering, a long beaded necklace, and white armbands. He holds a long, pale pole diagonally across his body. Attached to his waist is a long, curved, dark-pointed object extending upward toward his chest.

Surrounding him are several other men; some wear t-shirts and backpacks, while others are shirtless. To the left, a man in a tank top looks sideways. To the right, a man in an open white shirt and jeans walks forward. The crowd fills the background, though the figures further back are less distinct.

Large white text overlaid on the bottom half reads "DALAM SEKAM API PAPUA." Below this, smaller white text includes the name "BENNY WENDA" in red. At the top, white text reads "LONCENG KEMATIAN KOMISI ANTIKORUPSI." A barcode, price "RP 45.000," and the date "2-8 SEPTEMBER 2019" appear in the bottom right corner. A thin red border runs along the left edge.
